rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 3AA label, but the image is soft-focused and does not clearly support detailed claims such as evenly distributed cohesive TE or a clearly enlarged blastocoel; some features are inferred rather than directly visible.
Thoroughly integrates age, prior live births, AMH/FSH discordance, PCOS diagnosis, endometrial thickness, oocyte yield, sperm motility, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with conclusions generally supported by the case data; minor overstatement of embryo quality/prognosis and some speculative interpretation of the AMH-PCOS discrepancy prevent a perfect score.

Largely aligned with Gardner grading concepts and standard IVF practice, including luteal support and individualized future planning; slight deviations include somewhat strong endorsement of PGT-A discussion and protocol suggestions based on limited reserve data.

Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer and future cycles, including reserve reassessment, protocol review, and sperm/ICSI considerations; useful clinically, though some suggestions remain somewhat general.
